Class AetherisNotebookPanel.MoodKeep

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.AetherisNotebookPanel.MoodKeep
Enclosing class:
AetherisNotebookPanel
private static final class AetherisNotebookPanel.MoodKeep extends Object
The class MoodKeep is one user's version-1 mood record. The field line starts empty and holds the mood text. The field on says whether that mood is on. The field pending says whether a mood change is still pending. The field width is the saved dialog width. The field height is the saved dialog height. The field pins is the map from a canvas id to a cell id. The field blocked means the file text could not be read as version 1. A bad file stays unread. A caller uses fresh() to build an empty record. The type has no other method. The type does not read the file. The type does not write the file.

      static AetherisNotebookPanel.MoodKeep fresh()
